verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a My Cake Portal where employees view their individual holdings, plus digital certificate issuance and e-signing for admin and board approvals. Nothing documents an employee-initiated online option exercise, exercise payment, or share issuance triggered by an exercise. Viewing holdings and admin-side certificate tools are adjacent features, not the exercise workflow this story asks for.

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms
